I’m Tara, a licensed massage therapist, business owner, and wellness professional with over 20 years of experience helping people move better, feel better, and live with less pain.

This channel combines evidence-based massage therapy education with real-life business ownership. You’ll find videos on therapeutic massage, myofascial release, lymphatic drainage, cupping, recovery, mobility, stress management, and practical wellness—without the hype

I also share the behind-the-scenes reality of running two massage therapy practices: FL Massage Associates in the Florida Keys and NJ Massage Associates in New Jersey, while balancing family, business, and everyday life

Expect massage education, wellness tips, recovery strategies, client FAQs, industry insights, business ownership lessons, and plenty of stories from more than two decades in the treatment room

If you’re interested in wellness, entrepreneurship, and an honest look at life as a massage therapist, subscribe and join the journey
